'''International relations'''
*[[Climate change policy of the United States]], [[Proposals for the United States to withdraw from the United Nations]]
**The United States announces its withdrawal from dozens of [[United Nations]] bodies, including the [[Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change]], the [[United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change|Framework Convention on Climate Change]], the [[United Nations Population Fund|UN Population Fund]], [[UN Trade and Development]] and four of the [[United Nations Economic and Social Council#Regional commissions|Economic and Social Council's regional commissions]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260108-trump-pulls-us-out-of-key-climate-treaty-science-body-white-house (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Cross-strait relations]]
**[[Government of China|China]] bans [[Taiwan]]ese [[Ministry of the Interior (Taiwan)|interior minister]] [[Liu Shyh-fang]] and [[Ministry of Education (Taiwan)|education minister]] [[Cheng Ying-yao]], along with their relatives, from entering the country, alleging their involvement in the [[Taiwan independence movement]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-takes-punitive-actions-three-taiwanese-independence-activities-2026-01-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Political status of the Cook Islands and Niue]], [[Foreign relations of Niue]]
**[[Germany]] formally recognizes and establishes diplomatic relations with the [[Pacific]] island of [[Niue]], with the German mission in [[Wellington]], [[New Zealand]], coordinating ties. Niue remains in [[Associated state|free association]] with New Zealand. [https://news.yahoo.com/articles/germany-recognize-niue-pacific-island-155527716.html (DPA via Yahoo News)]
*[[Somalia–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department]] suspends all ongoing assistance programs to [[Somalia]], alleging that the [[Government of Somalia|Somali government]] destroyed an American-funded [[World Food Programme]] warehouse and stole 76 tonnes of [[humanitarian aid|food aid]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-somalia-food-assistance-suspension-a34b91e229c195a723ce2c8f9e6bb158 (AP)]
